      "observations": [
        "All 251 owned diff lines across four paths were read, including the full added browser task and all 36 CRLF fixture lines. Metadata and product/directive checks covered the owned files before bodies; the needed MIME receiver has no product exclusion. No Suite evidence is used.",
        "The operation now collects candidate fingerprints in an array and remembers unlocked passwords in a Map keyed by fingerprint. The retry callback obtains its actual key fingerprint, returns false when that lookup fails, frees that temporary fingerprint and selects the matching password. This adopts the review's early-return form and the author's correction for keys with different manual passwords.",
        "The hidden-recipient flag is set before verification. A temporary ctypes callback is held through the synchronous native execute call, the default native password provider is restored, and only then does JavaScript await candidate unlocking. The loop checks available secret material and tracker state; it does not guarantee every candidate unlocks. The new map retains password strings across the retry. Tracker forget clears the tracker reference, not the map, so this is not proof of immediate secret erasure or a general native lifetime guarantee.",
        "The accepted callback/retry windows retain this behavior. The actual tracker relocks only keys it unlocked and forgets its handle/password without destroying the handle; the caller then destroys that handle. Native setter failure, absent map entries, callback buffer edge cases, multiple distinct passwords and exception/concurrent-operation paths are not directly asserted by the added test. Native callback/ABI, null-destroy tolerance and cryptographic correctness were not independently executed or verified.",
        "The new task opens one Alice fixture and directly asserts body substring, no signed icon and an encrypted-ok icon, with nonempty expected-behavior messages containing should. It does not explicitly arrange several differently protected secret keys or test cancellation, wrong passwords, failure cleanup or used-recipient key-ID display. The fixture's owned and accepted blobs are identical; static armor decoding exposes eight zero bytes at decoded offsets 3–10. No plaintext was recovered here.",
        "The actual MIME receiver passes the byte string through RNP.decrypt into decryptArray, then consumes returned status/data and suppresses failed decrypted data. The existing byte-string/array lesson is reused only for that representation boundary. Both required retained primary/review scopes are now reconciled; historical reproduction and native API proposals do not establish a fresh decryption or security result.",
        "Full retained primary description, current numbered 0–17 bodies, activity and end controls were read with the original A scope/time. The initial Apple Mail direction is clarified by the author, who reports a zero key ID and GnuPG/RNP comparisons. The RNP author's possible performance/unlock concerns, environment-variable idea and later manual-key-choice proposal remain attributed discussion. Private samples, keys, screenshot pixels, upstream issue/PR and dependencies remain unread.",
        "The primary explicitly separates the Thunderbird decryption patch from obtaining the used recipient key ID, which the author says required an upstream API fix. This is the historical limitation at that phase, not a claim about every later accepted native version or current UI.",
        "Full D302785 creation-to-close timeline and its actual inline body were read with original C3 collector ownership/time. Initial acceptance states that the reviewer did not know how to test and asks for a test. The author then says the initial patch was incorrect, explains distinct manually protected key passwords and adds the test. The landed source has the fingerprint map and adopts the inline early-return guard; Done alone is not the adoption evidence.",
        "The final test directly asserts the Alice fixture body and security icons. It does not explicitly arrange multiple differently protected keys or test all callback/error/cancel/native lifetime paths. Historical build completion followed by ongoing-or-failed-build landing is not a new clean-run claim. No key, decryption, native ABI, browser or security execution occurred.",
        "Both required retained discussion scopes resolve the source-only pending marker. The original source records and times remain exact. Existing byte-string/array knowledge is reused only for its verified representation boundary, without duplicate earlier audit credit."
      ],
